steps.comment: Headless renders battle animations in software at about three frames a second, so playing two boss phases here would take an hour and would only re-test what battle_mook and balance.py already cover. Instead, run the finale's own command list with the battles, the message windows and the choice windows stripped out: what is left is the part that changes the game - switches, the receipt, the trope tally, the return to the title screen - and it runs without waiting for a single key press.

steps.label: and the game returns to the title
